accessibility.evidence: Scoped manual/DOM checks: all launch inputs have labels; one main and h1 on report; seed error has alert/invalid association; keyboard Tab displays focus, modal Tab remains on Close and Escape closes. Measured launch muted text contrast 6.59:1 against its actual computed background. JS matchMedia emulation exercised Phaser reduced-motion branch (canvas data-reduced-motion=true, 329 fixture events); CSS reduced-motion rules inspected. This is not a full WCAG, axe, screen-reader or native OS reduced-motion certification.

responsive.evidence: Actual browser layouts inspected at 375,430,768,1440 CSS px. No document horizontal overflow in checked launch/viewer/report.
